sandbox_image.distribution: The image published to GitHub Container Registry for 0.9.11, pulled with scripts/pull-sandbox.sh on 2026-11-25 (ghcr.io/henrycooper86/oxfuzz-fuzz-sandbox@sha256:44b0b5f951634e368e5ed8acb25da84b3ab8a12913ac6fddddf6c23d3620677d) and tagged with the local name. 0.9.12 uses the same image as 0.9.11.

scenarios_passed: Network unavailable, input read-only, explicitly mounted output writable, 256 MiB and 1 CPU cgroup limits verified
Explicit numeric UID/GID can read private input and creates correctly owned output
Running container registered with owned workspace label
Runtime ownership records inaccessible inside the sandbox
Fresh runtime cleans up container left by terminated helper client
helper: Seventh test is the recovery child-process helper, not an independent scenario.
device_policy: Unchanged since 0.9.11: the runtime accepts exactly /dev/kvm as a passthrough device, only when the host has it as a character device, and refuses any other device before Docker runs. Covered by unit and integration tests in CI; this macOS host has no /dev/kvm, so no device was passed here.

semgrep.provenance: The 0.2.4 image build runs an offline Semgrep scan with a read-only source mount and checks its report on the host. That check is part of building the image; it was not repeated for this record, and the image is unchanged since 0.9.11.

limitations: Host is macOS arm64; this is not a Linux host qualification. Windows is not supported.
Docker failure recovery scenarios cover only disposable owned containers.
All seven tests reported ok (six scenarios and the recovery helper).
Only the linux/arm64 image was used here; the linux/amd64 image was built and verified by the GitHub workflow, not run through these scenarios.

The Docker socket was named with DOCKER_HOST (OrbStack's socket), because this host has no /var/run/docker.sock and the runs redirect HOME. A first attempt without it failed every isolation test before any container started; that attempt is kept with the evidence and is not counted.
candidate_delta: None known. The run was made in a separate worktree checked out at the tag commit, with no other changes in it; the engine qualification in the same worktree recorded an empty working-tree patch at 08:03Z. No digest was taken for this run itself.
